def transform(grid):
 g=[r[:] for r in grid];h=len(g);w=len(g[0]); active=[sum(v==0 for v in row)>2 for row in g]; bands=[];r=0
 while r<h:
  if not active[r]:r+=1;continue
  s=r
  while r+1<h and active[r+1]:r+=1
  bands.append((s,r));r+=1
 payloads=[]
 for s,e in bands:
  cols=[c for r in range(s,e+1) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==0];a,b=min(cols),max(cols)
  payload={(r,c):g[r][c] for r in range(s,e+1) for c in range(a,b+1) if g[r][c] in (0,9)};payloads.append(payload)
 for p in payloads:
  for r,c in p:g[r][c]=7
 fixed={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=7}
 for p in payloads:
  dr=0
  while all(r+dr+1<h and (r+dr+1,c) not in fixed for r,c in p):dr+=1
  for (r,c),v in p.items():g[r+dr][c]=v
 return g
